h: Moshe Prepares Israel to Inherit the Hidden Light

p: "A parable of the people of a province, etc.;
that Sichon and Og fell before him,
he said: Now is the time
for me to ask to enter the land;
as referring to the downfall of Sichon and Og.
the expression "at that time" is written six times
the downfall of Sichon and Og.
אֵצֶל סִיחוֹן וְאֵצֶל עוֹג (דְּבָרִים ב, לד; ג, ד)
ג) וַנִּקַּח בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֶת הָאָרֶץ
3) "And we took at that time the land
מִיַּד שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמוֹרִי (דְּבָרִים ג, ח)
from the hand of the two kings of the Emori" (Devarim 3:8).
עַד אֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ ה׳ לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם
"until Hashem gives rest to your brothers as to you,
וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם הֵם אֶת הָאָרֶץ (דְּבָרִים ג, יח, כ)
and they too inherit the land" (Devarim 3:18, 20).
"And I pleaded with Hashem at that time"
that is, at the time of the conquest of Sichon and Og,
But all this needs to be understood:
why was the conquest of Sichon and Og
specifically with the expression "at that time"?
But the matter is that this refers
to what is said three times,
at the beginning of Parashas Devarim,
"And I commanded you at that time
that the meaning of "at that time" is
at the time when Yisrael were
as is written in the Midrash Rabbah
in their glory and their tranquility
and said: How can I carry by myself," etc.
And this is what it says (Devarim 1:6):
"Hashem our God spoke to us at Chorev:
you have dwelt long enough," etc.;
and Rashi explained from the Midrash:
has come for your dwelling at the mountain"
that is, they merited the Torah there;
to merit the light of Torah she'b'al peh.
"And I said to you at that time"
when you were at a great level
so that there be fixed in you
the words of Torah and the light
"Hashem your God has multiplied you," etc.
that you are at so high a level;
the yetzer hara can still enter;
and as they expounded, of blessed memory
לָכֵן הָבוּ לָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים (דְּבָרִים א, יג)
each one to his own people,
"and I will place them at your heads"
on the heads of their judges
(as is written in the Sifrei; Sifrei Devarim 13)
they will be able to uplift you
at which the words of Torah will be fixed in you
when you were at a high level;
and through my having given of my power
through this they will be able
to bring the words of Torah into your hearts,
so that they be fixed forever and ever.
"And I commanded you at that time
indicates the fixing of the words of Torah,
which is the power of Torah she'b'al peh.
קָאֵי כָּל הַג׳ פְּעָמִים בָּעֵת הַהִוא
all three times "at that time" refer
when he saw them in their glory,
And all this he said to them
אַחֲרֵי הַכּוֹתוֹ אֵת סִיחוֹן וְגוֹ׳ (דְּבָרִים א, ד)
from the punishment of the generation of the Flood,
that Og was at the sides of the Ark
and did not need the Ark;
for he thought that he was clean
of the sin of the generation of the Flood,
which was in the blemish of the covenant;
and Sichon was born in the Ark
and they were, in the kelipah,
of the attribute of Tzaddik Yesod Olam
and of the attribute of Malchus,
and extracted from them all their vitality,
to bring the light of Torah she'b'al peh
And this is why "at that time" is mentioned nine times
which corresponds to the attribute of Yesod,
of the seed of Yosef HaTzaddik,
and corresponded to the attribute of
from Keser Elyon to the attribute of Tzaddik.
And this is what it says, "your eyes have seen":
and also all of Yisrael who were worthy merited,
and to feel in their souls
the conquest of Sichon and Og;
that they extracted all their root of life;
that are said about the time
of the conquest of Sichon and Og
קָאֵי עַל ג׳ פְּעָמִים בָּעֵת הַהִוא
refer to the three times "at that time"
mentioned at the beginning of Parashas Devarim,
where the intent of "at that time" is
"And I pleaded with Hashem at that time"
after the conquest of Sichon and Og,
when he asked to cross into Eretz Yisrael
that is, to bring in through his seeing
the light "that it is good" into the land,
which denotes the attribute of Malchus,
so that Yisrael would merit through him
the light of Torah she'b'al peh.
from the beginning of Parashas Devarim until here,
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus.
that he would see from across the Jordan
and hand the matter over to Yehoshua,
"for he shall cause them to inherit the land
would also serve to bring in
And the one who conquers and apportions
וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמוֹד (בְּמִדְבַּר כז, כא)
"and before Elazar the Kohen he shall stand" (Bamidbar 27:21),
after the passing of Moshe Rabbeinu,
"at whose word they shall go out
and at whose word they shall come in,
to merit the light "that it is good,"
as is written in Sefer HaBahir:
and put it for them in its place,
and the rest He hid away for the tzaddikim," etc.;
and it is the light that was hidden away
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar
and this is what is written
we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
